full_judgment:
In this appeal by the defendants arising out of a suit for redemption of a mortgage which was dismissed by the learned Munsiff but which on appeal was decreed by the learned Subordinate Judge, the only point urged by Mr. Aminul Huq, learned. Advocate for the appellant, is that the plaintiff being purchaser of a sham in the equity of redemption cannot redeem the whole mortgage. 

 In the result, the appeal is dismissed with costs. The judgment and decree of the appellate Court below are affirmed.
